function.name: get_fleet_state
function.description: Live state of all robots (pose, velocity, task, goal, battery, motor temperature, error code, current inventory action), fleet counts, and the active problem events that code has detected. Each event has a stable id (E-0001), type, severity, facts, and the open orders in its zone with code-computed risk. Start here for any question about the fleet.

function.name: get_robot
function.description: One robot in detail: live telemetry, a timeline of its recent task changes, stops, errors and events, and its tickets. Use it to explain why a robot stopped or what it is doing.

function.name: get_zone_inventory
function.description: Stock in one zone: physical units vs the system count, empty bins, bins whose count differs from the system (missing stock), and the zone's open orders with due times and risk.

function.name: get_metrics
function.description: Fleet KPIs for briefs and recaps: robots moving/working/charging/with problems, deliveries per zone per minute, orders open/at risk/late/shipped, events raised, tickets by status, commissioning runs.

function.name: list_events
function.description: Problem events detected by code. status=active (default) for current problems, status=all to include cleared ones (for recaps).

function.name: open_ticket
function.description: Hand a problem to the Scheduler agent (Megha's Scheduler). Pass the event_id from get_fleet_state so code attaches the evidence. If a live ticket already exists for that event, the existing ticket is returned with duplicate=true instead of a new one.

event_type.description: The event's type, e.g. stuck, deadlock, overheat, low_battery, repeated_errors, throughput_drop, inventory_mismatch, low_stock

reason.description: One sentence: what is wrong and what the Scheduler should do

needed_by.description: HH:MM local time by which it must be handled, from the orders at risk

evidence.description: Optional extra evidence; the event's facts are attached automatically

function.name: patch_ticket
function.description: Update a ticket as the supervisor: change status (allowed transitions are enforced by code), priority, needed_by, or add a note.

function.name: list_tickets
function.description: Tickets with their status and history. Optional status filter: open, acknowledged, rescheduled, resolved, failed, escalated.

function.name: get_trust
function.description: Trust gate status for each robot skill or route: trials, successes, P(success rate >= 80%), and whether it is trusted. Only trusted subjects may be put into service; the rule is computed by code.

function.name: run_commission
function.description: Start commissioning an untrusted robot skill or route: a Thompson-sampling bandit runs simulated trials across candidate policies until one is 95% likely to succeed at least 80% of the time, or none can. Runs in the background and returns a job id; poll get_commission for batch-by-batch progress.

function.name: get_commission
function.description: Progress or result of a commissioning job: one line per batch, final decision (pass/fail/inconclusive), the chosen policy, failure clips. Omit job_id for the latest job.
